stations.title: orders count
stations.text: Reads each file whole before it counts.

captions: Idris keeps the year's orders in one file, and wants them counted on the old computer.
The tool reads each file whole first, and runs out of memory before it counts.
You read a line at a time, take standard input from a pipe, and stop when unread.
Now the year is counted in a little memory, and the tool joins a chain of programs.
Same tool, any size of file, and a link that fits between other programs.
